result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. I made one change, in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`.

The remainder condition now also requires `contributor.getContributor().isActive()`. Unmatched contributors whose latest commit is older than 180 days are left out. Configured teams are untouched and keep all their members.

Blank latest-commit dates already count as active, because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` returns true for them.

I ran the codeanalyzer `Landscape*` tests and they passed. I did not add a test for the new behaviour.
